your_book:
Wednesday was a broad-based down day for Jaleel's book, and there was nowhere to hide — every holding finished in the red except Neurocrine Biosciences (NBIX), which was essentially flat (+0.01%). The session's biggest damage came from Rocket Lab (RKLB), which shed another 4.25% and now sits 19.5% underwater on an AVOID-rated position. Lululemon (LULU) dropped 3.36%, deepening a loss that has now reached -22.0% with a guidance-cut risk flag still live ahead of the December 9 earnings date. S&P Global (SPGI) fell 2.55% and AstraZeneca (AZN) dropped 1.94% — both meaningful given their weights. The top-two holdings, Abbott (ABT, 10.5%) and NVIDIA (NVDA, 10.2%), each slipped modestly (-0.27% and -0.91% respectively), which cushioned the overall damage somewhat. The book's cumulative unrealized loss stands at -1.37%.

The most concerning drift continues in the consumer names. LULU is rated Strong Buy with a QARP score of 72.4, yet the thesis has been repeatedly undermined by Americas comp deterioration, tariff-driven margin pressure, and a stalled China recovery — price and thesis are clearly diverging. Similarly, BSX carries a Strong Buy verdict and a QARP of 79.6, but management itself guided flat through Q3 after slashing FY26 growth targets; the market is pricing in the operational disappointment, not the quality score. RKLB compounds the picture: AVOID-rated, near the lowest QARP in the book at 39.3, and carrying the largest single-day loss today.

Tomorrow brings the ADBE earnings report (flagged next: Sep 10), and that's the immediate focal point — the stock fell 0.93% today on sector-wide pressure tied to macro and Middle East concerns, and the narrative around AI disruption and CFO departure makes the reaction to any print unpredictable regardless of the numbers. NVDA's export-control overhang hasn't eased, and the new leveraged ETF headline around the name is the kind of retail-sentiment signal that can amplify volatility in both directions. Watch the pharma cluster (GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX) for any policy-pricing news given the MFN overhang flagged across the group.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated, -4.25% today, -19.5% cumulative — no thesis support
attention.note: With the lowest QARP in the book at 39.3 and an explicit AVOID verdict, today's 4.25% drop widens a loss that has no systematic basis for holding; this position is working against the capital-preservation mandate and warrants a clear sizing or exit decision.

attention.headline: Earnings tomorrow (Sep 10) with AI-disruption narrative and CFO exit overhang
attention.note: The risk flag explicitly warns that narrative — not numbers — is driving ADBE, meaning even a beat could trigger a sell-off; Jaleel's book needs a pre-print decision on whether to reduce exposure heading into the event.

attention.headline: Strong Buy verdict, -22.0% loss, guidance-cut flag — thesis and price badly divorced
attention.note: Five straight quarters of negative Americas comps, tariff margin pressure, and a stalled China business are structural, not transient; the gap between the STRONG BUY rating and the -22.0% cumulative loss demands a honest re-examination of whether the thesis still holds before December 9.

attention.headline: Management guided flat through Q3 yet verdict remains Strong Buy
attention.note: FY26 growth was cut from 10.5% to 7–8.5% with softness across Watchman, EP, and urology — the guidance signal from the company itself contradicts the Strong Buy verdict and warrants re-evaluation ahead of the October 28 print.
